Supplier contract risk review.overall: The contract meets the policy on payment terms, but is missing a liability cap and public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: Meals are invoiced every four weeks and payable within 30 days.
findings.note: Payment is due within 30 days, as the policy asks.
The contract does not limit the supplier's liability; its parent company guarantees its performance.
The contract does not require the supplier to hold public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: The Customer may extend the agreement once, for a further two years, by giving at least six months' written notice before the end of the initial three years. There is no other renewal.
findings.note: The contract can only be extended by the customer's choice, so it does not renew automatically.
Nothing in the contract shows the supplier handling personal data.
